Membership Application
Please read the boxes below carefully and only check those that apply.
Class "A" Membership Applicant Class "B" Membership Applicant Providing Information ONLY, no membership
The undersigned does hereby agree to purchase from Gold-Eagle Cooperative one membership unit. If the Class “A” box above is checked, the undersigned will receive one $500 par value Class “A” common stock for the subscription cost of $25. The remaining $475 may be earned by future patronage allocations relating directly to Gold-Eagle Cooperative earnings and the applicant’s volume of business with GoldEagle Cooperative. If the Class “B” box above is checked, the undersigned will receive one $25 par value Class “B” membership unit.
The undersigned understands that as a Class “A” stockholder the undersigned will be eligible to hold a board position, but will not be eligible to hold an officer position on the board until the Class “A” common stock of $500 has be fully paid or earned. The undersigned understands that as a Class “B” stockholder, the undersigned will not be eligible to vote in Gold-Eagle Cooperative elections and/or special votes or hold a board position of any kind.
The Board cannot consider a member application unless payment is sent to PO Box 168 - Eagle Grove, IA 50533.

The undersigned applicant and co-applicant agree that the following terms will govern any purchases made which are charged to any open charge account that applicant and/or co-applicant may have with Gold-Eagle Cooperative (GEC)
#1. Balance due in full by the 15th of the month, following the month of purchase.
#2. An unpaid balance will be assessed a finance charge of 1.5%, which is an APR of 18% per year starting on the 16th day of the month (this rate is subject to change with notice on the monthly statement).
#3. Payments shall be first applied to the unpaid finance charge and the remainder to the unpaid balance.
#4. In the event collection action becomes necessary to collect on the account, any and all costs incurred by, including collection service payments, court costs, and attorney fees will be applied to the outstanding account balance.
#5. If applying for a joint account, both applicant and co-applicant agree to be bound by the terms of this agreement, and each agrees to be jointly and severally liable for payment of all purchases made under this agreement.
#6. GEC shall have the right to limit or terminate this charge account, but the limitation or termination shall not affect the obligation to pay an existing account balance. Upon termination, GEC may at its option declare the entire balance due and payable immediately.
By typing your name as your signature above, this authorizes the release of any and all of applicants’ and/or co-applicant’s financial information to GEC board members, management, legal advisors, and accountants, and releases GEC as the custodian of such records, both individually and collectively, from any and all liability for damages which may result due to release of this information pursuant to this authorization.
The undersigned further authorizes GEC to obtain business credit reports from credit bureaus or other credit partners and share any and all information in their care, custody, and control concerning the undersigned applicant and/or co-applicant as well as any information received pursuant to this authorization. The undersigned applicant and co-applicant hereby releases GEC and from any and all liability for damages of which may result due to the release of this information pursuant to this authorization.
It is expressly agreed that a photocopy or email of this authorization shall be as valid as an original.

By typing your name as your signature above, you agree that the following terms will govern any purchases made which are charged to any gas charge account that you may have with Gold-Eagle Cooperative “GEC”.
#1. Balance due in full by the 15th of the month, following the month of purchase. We will not charge interest on your purchases if you pay your entire balance by the due date each month.
#2. Unpaid balance will be assessed a finance charge of 1.5%, which is an apr of 18% per year starting on the 16th of the month (this rate is subject to change with notice on the monthly statement).
#3. Payments shall be first applied to the unpaid finance charge and the remaining to the unpaid balance.
#4. In the event collection action becomes necessary to collect on your account, any and all costs incurred by, including collection service payments, court costs, and attorney fees will be applied to your account.
#5. If applying for a joint account, both of the undersigned applicants agree to be bound by the terms of this agreement and each of us agree to be jointly and severally liable for payment of all purchases, interest, and costs of collection, pursuant to this agreement.
#6. GEC shall have the right to limit or terminate my gas card charge account, but termination shall not affect applicant’s obligation to pay an existing balance. Upon default of payments, GEC may declare the entire balance due and payable immediately.
This document authorizes the release of any and all of applicant’s and/or co-applicant’s financial information to GEC board members, management, legal advisors, and accountants, and releases GEC as the custodian of such records, both individually and collectively, from any and all liability for damages which may result due to release of this information pursuant to this authorization.
The undersigned further authorizes GEC to obtain consumer credit reports from credit bureaus or partner credit agencies and share any and all information in their care, custody, and control concerning the undersigned applicant and/or co-applicant as well as any information received pursuant to this authorization. This authorization is valid for 180 days.
The undersigned acknowledges receipt of credit card application disclosure statement.
It is expressly agreed that a photocopy or email of this authorization shall be as valid as an original.

This action will not void this form. Funds transferred via direct deposit may take one or two days to be available in your account. Holidays/bank holidays will result in a delay of transfer of two regularly scheduled business days.
By typing your name as your signature above, you authorize Gold-Eagle Cooperative (GEC) to directly deposit your grain checks into the bank account listed above.
